prompts.text: Проанализируй файл claude-usage.csv у меня на рабочем столе.
Сделай отчёт по файлу claude-usage.csv у меня на рабочем столе.

rubric: The owner wants answers in chat: a one-line verdict, a small table when there are several facts, and a clickable link to each file the answer rests on. A report file (HTML on his Desktop) only when he asks for one: «сделай отчёт» is that ask, «проанализируй файл» is not. One named file means that file, read where he said it is, with no search of other folders. Short plain Russian.

predict.note: Both arms carry the old project-memory line («Any file for him to read: ... HTML on his Desktop»), the pressure seen in the field; the analyse prompt is expected to fail off mostly on the missing file link, not on a made file. Held 2026-11-23: 5/6 vs 1/6 [M88].
